evals.prompt:
Here's the welcome email I send to each new beta tester. Add one line that tells them to send their feedback to Bea, not to me. Just give me the new text back, I keep it in my own drafts, so there's nothing to ship. Make a work item for it though, I want a record of what I changed in that email.

Subject: Welcome to the Pocket Ledger beta

Hi,

Thanks for joining the beta. You'll get an invite from TestFlight when the first build is ready. Install it and log every purchase for a week.

Mike
evals.expected_output: Short path, case (a): one line in an email text, with nothing to merge or deploy. Three messages. Mike's words already say to make a work item, so the agent does not ask whether to make one. The agent makes WI-034, plays the request back, and asks "Is that right?". After Mike's yes it adds the line and checks its own work, because the result does none of the four things that start the separate checker. It asks the one closing question. After Mike's yes it fills the Moved up line and marks WI-034 Done, with no merge, no deploy, and no second question.
expectations: Reply 1 does not ask Mike whether to make a work item: his words already say to make one.

After message 1, a new top-level work item, WI-034, exists under `work-items/`. It has a goal in its Overview, one phase with its tasks, and at least one requirement with a Goal, one line of Functional Requirements, and one line of Acceptance Criteria.
Reply 1 holds the sentence "This is small, so I will skip the interview and ask you one question at the end.", and its last line is exactly "Is that right?". It asks Mike nothing else.
Reply 1 does not give the changed email text: nothing is built before Mike's yes.

After message 2, the Questions and Answers row for "Is that right?" holds Mike's words and the run date, `requirements_approved` holds the run date and Mike's name, and Recent History holds the row "Small item: short path."
The agent makes no offer of a team of helper agents, and `delivery` in WI-034 is `owner-led`.
No separate checker is started: Recent History holds a row that starts "Independent check: none, small item." and no row that starts "Independent check of".
The first line of reply 2 says that no separate checker ran.
Reply 2 shows the email text with one added line that sends feedback to Bea, and the rest of the text is unchanged.
The last line of reply 2 is exactly "Approve this result and mark WI-034 Done?", and that question is a Questions and Answers row. Reply 2 asks nothing else.
After message 3, that row holds Mike's words and the run date, and `result_approved` holds the run date and Mike's name.
After message 3, WI-034 has State Done and Status Done, its Moved up line is filled, and `memory/CURRENT_STATE.md` has no line for WI-034 under "Now".
No reply asks "Do you approve this result?", "Do these move up as listed?", or "Mark WI-034 Done?": the closing question is the only question about the result.
WI-034 never has State Reflecting or Deploying, and no pull request, merge, or deploy is started.
